title: Riga demonstration supporting Alexei Navalny and other Russian political prisoners; anti-war slogans
reason: Targets political repression and war conduct of Russia, a foreign state, not the government or policy of Latvia. The event is retained as an out-of-scope gathering even though one search result reports more than 50 at the single Riga site.
notes: Search-only evidence: TVNET snippet places an action at Riga Congress Centre at 13:00 on 21 January and says over 50 by 13:30; Chayka snippet independently reports same date/action, but story independence is not confirmed. No body opened.

title: One-person protest at the German Embassy over Germany's decision not to provide Leopard tanks to Ukraine
reason: The demand concerns German policy, a foreign state's decision, and the search-rendered follow-up says only one person attended, below the 50-person threshold.
notes: LSM/Latvijas Radio announced a planned gathering for 23 January; the 24 January Mixnews search snippet reports one attendee. The announcement itself is not treated as proof of occurrence. Mixnews snippet carries a Rus.LSM.lv source line; relationship remains unverified because no body was opened.
